tips.title: BEAT THE STORY
tips.body: Cheats only work after the main story. Then a Cheats tab shows up in the Progress menu. Each of the 61 cheats has its own unlock.

tips.title: OPEN YOUR PHONE
tips.body: Press D-pad Up for the phone, hold L1/LB, press R1/RB, enter the code on the D-pad. No saving while on, no trophies until the session ends.

tips.title: $250,000 CASH
tips.body:
UP, RIGHT, DOWN, LEFT, UP, LEFT, DOWN, RIGHT
The only money cheat. No saving while it's on.

tips.title: INFINITE AMMO
tips.body:
DOWN, UP, RIGHT, DOWN, LEFT, LEFT, UP, DOWN, DOWN, DOWN
Win the medals at shooting ranges.

tips.title: BODY ARMOR
tips.body:
DOWN, UP, LEFT, UP, UP, UP, UP, UP, DOWN, DOWN
Adds armor. Save first, then cheat.
